items.title: Wall Street rallies by $1tn even as Bailey warns AI may not pay off
items.summary: Wall Street gained $1tn (£740bn) on Monday after shrugging off fears of an AI bubble and a national security scandal at Nvidia.

items.title: Reindeer Launches on Google Cloud Marketplace, Expanding Collaboration with Google Cloud to Help Enterprises Move Agentic AI into Core Operations
items.summary: Reindeer, an enterprise agentic AI company that builds and runs AI agents for complex core operations, today announced an expanded collaboration with Google Cloud. Reindeer has graduated from the Google Cloud ISV Startup Springboard program, and its platform is now available on Google Cloud Marketplace. Large enterprises now have a direct path to put Reindeer agents enabled by Google's Gemini models to work on the Google Cloud infrastructure they already run.

items.title: What we know — and what we don't — as Nvidia investigates an alleged spy plot involving its CEO
items.summary: Stunning allegations of a spy plot have prompted Nvidia to investigate whether its founder and CEO, Jensen Huang, was the target of a “foreign intelligence effort."Huang on Sunday admitted to having an extramarital affair, and acknowledged that news reports surrounding the relationship and potential national security concerns led Nvidia's board to investigate.
